query: Yellowknife Northwest Territories Canada taxi Uber fare per km base fare 2026
snippet: Uber is currently unavailable in Yellowknife, NT. Standard-class taxi: 5 km trip costs CAD $11, 10 km trip CAD $18, 20 km ride CAD $33, 50 km ride CAD $77 (approx CAD $1.10/km). Meter rate last increased in 2019 to $0.24 per 100 meters traveled (CHF equivalent CAD $2.40/km on the meter). A draft bylaw proposes a fare increase of roughly 25-29 percent.
